where: background cliff on the top left
desc: The background cliff abruptly cuts off into flat gray placeholder geometry, exposing untextured level boundaries.

verify.why: The background cliff fades naturally into atmospheric haze and fog rather than terminating in flat placeholder geometry.

where: wooden fence posts along the cliff path
desc: The fence posts clip directly into the uneven rock terrain without natural anchors or proper ground alignment.

verify.why: The fence posts follow the path edge naturally according to the simplified, blocky construction style of the scene.

where: covered archway along the main path
desc: The primary path leads into a heavily shadowed, cluttered structure, making it ambiguous where the player can walk next.

verify.why: The path through the archway is clearly lit by lanterns and completely open, presenting no navigation ambiguity.

where: rock ridge on the left side of the path
desc: The cliff wall along the path is a paper-thin hollow mesh with visible open edges underneath.

verify.why: The rock ridge is a fully sculpted solid 3D terrain mesh rather than a paper-thin hollow shell.

where: base of the tree on the right cliff
desc: The tree trunk attaches awkwardly to the sheer cliff face without visible roots or soil grounding.

verify.why: The tree on the cliff is anchored to a visible wooden support framework attached directly to the rock face.

where: autumn trees on the right cliff wall
desc: The tree's foliage and trunk clip directly into the vertical rock cliff face without a natural ledge or root structure.

verify.why: Stylized trees growing out of rock faces with built-in wooden supports are intentional thematic details, not broken geometry.

where: banner line across the central path
desc: The line of decorative flags appears to float in mid-air without clear attachment points on either end.

verify.why: The banner string is clearly tied to the wooden building on the right and a post structure on the left.

where: background cliff wall at top left
desc: The upper background rock wall forms an unmodeled flat texture plane terminating abruptly at the level boundary.

verify.why: The background rock wall features consistent texture and lighting that recedes into fog, not an unmodeled flat plane.

where: upper center path near background structures
desc: The main street leads into dense shadows and complex overhead scaffolding in the background, making it unclear whether the path continues or hits a dead end.

verify.why: The ground street clearly remains visible and open as it passes under the background scaffolding.

where: foreground roof on the bottom left
desc: The large roof in the lower-left foreground heavily obstructs the view of the ground path and space behind it.

verify.why: This is an elevated camera perspective meant to showcase the village layout, not an in-game camera obstruction issue.

where: center path between buildings in deep shadow
desc: Harsh cast shadows completely obscure the ground terrain and pathing through the center of the village, hiding potential obstacles or routes.

verify.why: The ground details and path outlines remain completely legible within the shadow areas.

where: bunting line on the right roof
desc: The suspended bunting wire clips directly through the wooden roof tiles of the structure on the right.

verify.why: The bunting string hangs in open air between lantern posts and does not penetrate the roof tiles.

desc: It is unclear whether the elevated wooden platform and bridge in the background are playable pathways or non-interactive scenery.

verify.why: Elevated background structures are standard environmental design and do not pose a visual bug or game-breaking issue.

desc: The wooden walkway consists of fragmented, disconnected, and floating planks with inconsistent gaps.

verify.why: The fragmented and gapped planks are an intentional environmental art choice depicting a worn, dilapidated wooden dock.

desc: A wooden platform floats freely on top of the water without any pilings or supporting structures beneath it.

verify.why: Wooden debris and platform segments naturally float on water, so the absence of vertical pilings is entirely expected.

where: in the water below the pier
desc: A wooden plank structure floats isolated in the water with no visible support or connection to the docks.

verify.why: Wooden structures naturally float on the water surface, making rigid supports unnecessary for floating platform debris.

where: wooden scaffolding structures along the cliff
desc: The dense cluster of timber supports and ramps along the cliff makes walkable paths ambiguous and hard to distinguish from decorative structure.

verify.why: The primary walkable route is clearly highlighted with a distinct green moss surface, easily distinguishing it from decorative timber framing.
